pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggiranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.6: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhākaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggireyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:2.1.10: kāyaṃ vā kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ vā antamaso uppalapattaṃpi uccāreti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggirati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggirati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggirati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:2.2.4: anupasampannassa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggirati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
